properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Front Door: WAF Policy Must Be Associated
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Front Door profiles without an associated Web Application Firewall (WAF) policy. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7) and information system monitoring (SI-4). WAF provides Layer 7 application-level protection including OWASP rule sets, bot protection, and rate limiting for all traffic entering through Front Door.

metadata.description: Deny: Block non-compliant Front Door profiles without WAF. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
